fact: On 14 June 2026 the Minister of Economy and Trade and the chairman of Libya Post discussed launching a digital postal address for every company, linked to the commercial registry and company registration systems.
title: وزارة الاقتصاد وشركة بريد ليبيا يبحثان آليات إطلاق مشروع العنوان البريدي الرقمي للشركات
